features.title: Submit issue-URL builder
criteria: body is valid JSON for face and build
URL stays under GitHub's length limit or falls back to Copy JSON
features.evidence: npx vitest run tests/unit/submit: 17 tests pass (red first after D-45: 'Cannot find TEMPLATES'). Opens https://github.com/ChimeXXD/probuilds/issues/new with template=submit-face.yml or submit-build.yml, a title, and the face or build as compact JSON in the form's json field; as GitHub writes it into the issue (render: json, a code block) it parses back (readIssueBody) to the same object, which validateFace / validateBuild pass. Special characters, accents and emoji round-trip; no labels parameter (GitHub 404s it for people who can't label; the forms add [submission, face|build]). Over MAX_ISSUE_URL_LENGTH (6,500) it returns { prefilled: false } with the empty form's URL, never a cut JSON, for the page's Copy JSON. Tests also check both form files declare id: json with render: json and the labels. Limit from curl on 23 Nov 2026, signed out: 6,986 characters redirected to login, 7,026 failed with 500, 8,166 with 414.
